Dynamic date/time in JSX without suppressHydrationWarning. Add suppressHydrationWarning to the containing element to prevent SSR mismatch (ADR-006).

Hardcoded hex color detected. Use CSS custom properties from globals.css (e.g. var(--color-terracotta)) or Tailwind classes. Project color constants live in src/lib/constants.ts.
External state library detected. Rotato uses React Context + useReducer only (ADR-002). Remove this import.
